name: useNetwork
summary: Connection type, address and whether traffic actually goes anywhere.
plain: Whether the phone is online, how it is connected, and whether that connection costs money. Check isConnected before any network call, and isMetered before a large download.
description: Reads from expo-network: interface type, IP address, reachability and airplane mode. Being connected to Wi-Fi is not the same as having internet, which is why isConnected reflects a usable route rather than merely an attached interface. isMetered marks connections where the user pays per byte, typically cellular or a hotspot.

returns.name: isConnected
returns.desc: Whether a usable internet route exists, not merely an attached interface.

returns.name: isMetered
returns.desc: Whether the user pays for this traffic. Gate large transfers on it.

actions.name: refreshNetwork()
actions.desc: Re-runs the connectivity check immediately, for example when the app returns to the foreground.
actions.output: Resolves once the read completes. Each sub-read fails independently, so one missing value does not blank the rest.

agentNote: Check isConnected before every network call and isMetered before anything large. Never assume Wi-Fi means free or fast.
